_comment: THE PINNED SET the subject leg's gate (scripts/a2a-subject/boot.sh assert_tck_number) is allowed to see FAIL and still call the leg green. Full reasoning, dated, lives in WAIVERS.md -- this file is the machine-checkable pin of exactly one entry from that ledger, not a second copy of the reasoning. A requirement failing OUTSIDE this set is RED, full stop; a requirement in this set that STARTS PASSING is reported (retire it, do not silently keep the waiver); a requirement failing INSIDE this set is the expected, unchanged state.
